Active Directory.Permissions: Authenticated domain read access; no write delegation.
Active Directory.Prerequisites: RSAT ActiveDirectory and network access to a domain controller.
Active Directory.TypicalDuration: Seconds to a few minutes depending on directory size.

Entra ID.Permissions: User.Read.All and/or Group.Read.All as required by the report.
Entra ID.Prerequisites: Microsoft.Graph modules and an authenticated Graph context.
Entra ID.TypicalDuration: Seconds to several minutes; owner checks perform additional paged calls.

Exchange Online.Permissions: View-Only Recipients or an equivalent read-only Exchange role.
Exchange Online.Prerequisites: ExchangeOnlineManagement and an authenticated Exchange Online session.
Exchange Online.TypicalDuration: Seconds to several minutes depending on recipient count.

Hybrid Reports.Permissions: Read access to every source used by the selected report.
Hybrid Reports.Prerequisites: Connect each source named in the report description.
Hybrid Reports.TypicalDuration: Several minutes in large hybrid environments.

Security / IAM.Permissions: Read-only directory permissions; privileged reports do not require remediation rights.
Security / IAM.Prerequisites: Connect the source associated with the selected function.

Executive Summary.Prerequisites: Run operational reports first to create history snapshots.

Exports.Permissions: Local write access to Reports and Archive.
Exports.TypicalDuration: Seconds; large data sets may take longer.

Entra.UsersWithoutMFAMethods.Prerequisites: Microsoft.Graph.Reports and an authenticated Graph context.

Exchange.FullAccessMailboxPermissions.Permissions: View-Only Recipients plus permission to read mailbox permission entries.

Exchange.SendAsPermissions.Permissions: View-Only Recipients plus permission to read recipient permission entries.
